response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development, including C/C++ in earlier roles (e.g., National Instruments), but lacks recent or focused experience in high-performance C++ development for industrial automation or cybersecurity (IEC 62443). Their expertise leans heavily toward web/mobile development and scripting languages, with minimal evidence of scalable, multi-threaded, or secure system design required for this role.
strengths: Strong background in C/C++ from roles like National Instruments, demonstrating foundational low-level programming skills.
Experience with performance optimization and real-time systems (e.g., low-latency apps with DLang), indicating capability in performance-critical development.
Proven track record in secure development practices (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development) and mentorship, aligning with agile collaboration requirements.
concerns: Limited recent or specialized experience in C++ for industrial automation or cloud platforms; current work focuses on TypeScript, Node.js, and AI-agent infrastructure.
No explicit mention of experience with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or secure development lifecycle (SDL) practices.
Lack of demonstrated expertise in message brokers, IoT protocols (MQTT/Modbus), or distributed systems required for on-premises/cloud solutions in automation.
